🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-11-07 23:00 → 2026-11-08 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**
> **MCP hardening opened, then independently checked** — the test-runner allowlist fix drew an offline reproduction that confirmed the shell metacharacter guard and named one residual gap. [PR #88](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/88)

> **Revamped identity assets drew strong peer praise** — the refreshed logo work and video cut were welcomed for the careful manual work behind the vectorization. [tg:tawg:6257]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### zkIE
_A deeper proving rework arrived, pairing correctness work with speed._

- Jimmy Shi **Opened** a proving-stack refactor that pairs soundness hardening with a performance overhaul, giving the proving path a firmer correctness baseline and faster runs for everyone building on it. [PR #47](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/47)

### recompute-kit
_The tool-safety work picked up an independent verification pass._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Reviewed** the test-runner allowlist change and reproduced the argument guard offline, confirming the shell metacharacter checks hold while flagging that arbitrary HTTPS repositories are still accepted — the kind of independent check that keeps a security fix honest. [tg:tawg:6274]

### brand & press
_Visual identity work moved from draft assets toward deliverables the group can share._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Opened** a dedicated media-and-press channel for designs, logos, videos and press packs, giving the visual side a shared space where anyone can adjust and contribute. [tg:tawg:6240]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Charted** the finishing path for the identity assets, flagging the manual vectorization and lossless outline versions still needed so the marks scale cleanly across every surface. [tg:tawg:6249]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Outlined** a video-and-audio harness that is partly built and named the compute ceiling that currently stretches a track to hours, making the next infrastructure need concrete. [tg:tawg:6260]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Flagged** the audio track as the last polish item on the video cut, pointing finishing attention at the detail that most shapes how the piece lands. [tg:tawg:6259]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Decide how repository inputs should be constrained in the tool: reject arbitrary HTTPS remotes outright or gate them behind an explicit allowlist.
- Compare a heavier GPU box against a lighter video model to see which shortens media render cycles without losing quality.
- Treat the press-and-media channel as the single home for brand assets, with lossless exports stored next to the working files.

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Finish the manual vectorization and lossless outline versions of the identity assets.
- Run an audio polish pass on the video cut.
- Resolve the remaining repository-acceptance gap raised in the review of PR #88.
- Line up a review pass on the proving refactor, checking the soundness claims alongside the speed changes.

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**
> **Today's spark:** A security fix and its independent offline reproduction showed up within hours of each other, closing the loop while the change was still fresh.
>
> Keep that rhythm rolling: ship, double-check, ship again. The bots are taking notes. 🤖
